I stapled my repeat prescriptions to the form and the receptionist said that was great. I had to meet to pharmacy tech as govt guidance had recently changed re one of my meds (fair). Thank god for the staff at Boots (both of them). I've yet to see appointment booking active. It's always on emergency only. Maybe it's my cookies or something. Half an hour wait to speak to someone on the phone. Explained to the doctor on the phone I needed capsules for one medicineas I choke on the tablets so she prescribed tablets. I have to go in to ask for a prescription now. You can't give 0 stars so 1 star is equivalent of 0 stars. They get a star for the fact the staff are nice and polite under trying conditions.
